item.text: The live smoke test now covers the central behaviors: tap order is preserved, preferences attach to the first unassigned passenger, replacement targets the first draft passenger, ordinary Back discards picker edits, and explicit confirmation removes the departed passenger’s preference without transferring it to the newly added passenger. I’m checking reload persistence next, then I’ll write the required rollout record.
